column2: Generates a metric/dimension data dictionary for a Databricks table (Metric_type / Name / Formula / Description, sectioned by family, plus Dimensions, Datasources, Glossary tables). Give a table name and/or defining SQL; it queries Databricks for real columns, sample data, and distinct values, classifies each column as Normal (raw) or Custom (derived), and writes grounded descriptions. Use whenever the user pastes a Databricks table/SQL and asks to document it, describe metrics/dimensions, build a data dictionary, or explain query fields — even without saying "skill" or "dictionary". Trigger on "describe this table", "what metrics does X have", "document this query", "data dictionary for X".
column3: Onboarding onto an unfamiliar table before querying it; documenting a dashboard's SQL for reuse; handing a table to a teammate/agent needing grounded formulas; auditing if a metric behaves differently across tables; building a shared glossary for a game/app analytics table.
